rca of the issue: Two bugs discovered. (1) Showcase footer JSX (lines 1200-1233 pre-fix) was placed inside SectionLoyalty component instead of BrandEquityDashboardPage. SectionLoyalty only receives {study, aggregate, ai} as props; isShowcase, data, responseCount, targetN are undefined in that scope. When isShowcase truthy, React tried to evaluate `{isShowcase && ...}` → ReferenceError → showcase page crashed with runtime-error overlay. FIX: moved the entire footer block up to the main component's render tree, just before the closing of be-root. (2) be-dashboard-regen-insights button inside be-dash-ai right-rail was unconditionally rendered; since the right-rail is shown both in owner and showcase modes (to display master_insights), the button leaked into public view. FIX: wrapped button in {!isShowcase && (...)}. Reproduction: visit /showcase/e936845d9491 on main branch pre-fix — full-screen dev error overlay 'isShowcase is not defined at SectionLoyalty'. Post-fix: page renders cleanly with 0 console errors and all showcase testids visible.
